title: Military Family Life

sections.heading: Chaplains Religious Enrichment Development Operation
sections.markdown: Our goal is to help enrich and strengthen people's lives. Join the many who have reaped significant benefits from attending a CREDO retreat.

sections.heading: Exceptional Family Member Program
sections.markdown: EFMP helps active duty service members with managing the special needs of a family member.

sections.heading: Family Advocacy Program
sections.markdown: The Family Advocacy Program (FAP) is committed to fostering strong and meaningful relationships.

sections.heading: Family Member Employment Assistance Program
sections.markdown: FMEAP provides employment related referral services, career and skill assessments, career coaching, job search guidance, portable career opportunities, and education center referrals/guidance.

sections.heading: Marine Corps Family Team Building
sections.markdown: The Family Readiness Program provides Marines, Sailors, and their families with valuable resources and problem-solving skills to navigate military life. Problem-solving skills are an essential aspect of workshops led by Marine Corps Family Team Building (MCFTB).

sections.heading: Navy Marine Corps Relief Society
sections.markdown: MISSION: Build financial stability and well-being for Sailors, Marines and their families. VISION: To be the most trusted resource to meet the emerging needs of our global community of Sailors and Marines.
